projects.title: Cyber Kiosks
projects.description: As a Junior Software Developer at Sepalo Software, I participated in the implementation of cyber kiosks in various locations across Spain, bringing administration closer to citizens. These kiosks allow users to complete municipal procedures without going to the city center, offering services such as issuing residence certificates and payment of taxes and fees...

projects.title: Online Store
projects.description: Mundo Nómada is a web application developed with Angular that allows users to explore and manage a fashion and accessories store. The application provides an intuitive and modern user experience, following best UI/UX and accessibility practices.

aboutMe.paragraph1: I am Alejandro Colodrero, a web and cross-platform developer from Baena, Córdoba. At Accenture, I work as a Business Architecture Associate, carrying out Salesforce administration and application support for Repsol.
aboutMe.paragraph2: My work connects platform configuration and security with day-to-day operations: Production, QA and Pre-Production support, incident management in ServiceNow and release validation with Azure DevOps. I support Electricity and Gas teams during release windows and synchronization processes.
aboutMe.paragraph3: Previously, I worked in SAP ABAP development and payment kiosk software. I have completed DAM and DAW vocational qualifications and am developing my Salesforce expertise while preparing for the Salesforce Administrator certification. My B2 English supports working with technical documentation and in professional environments.

experience.title: Salesforce Administrator & Application Support
experience.description:
Business Architecture Associate

  • Users and security: administration of roles, profiles, Permission Sets, queues, public groups and delegated administration.
  • Environment support: operations across Production, QA and Pre-Production, including controlled script execution and consistency checks.
  • Incidents and changes: triage, tracking and resolution follow-up through ServiceNow.
  • Releases and Azure DevOps: deployment verification, destructive changes handling, Pull Request reviews and branch consistency checks.
  • Salesforce configuration: maintenance of Flows, Validation Rules, Objects, Record Types, Approval Processes and Email-to-Case.
  • Business support: assistance to Electricity and Gas teams during release windows and synchronization processes; contributions to technical debt reduction.

experience.title: SAP ABAP Developer
experience.description:
• Developed ABAP reports and maintained Data Dictionary structures; built interfaces using BDC (Batch Data Communication).
  • Worked on ETL workflows, data transformation and validation, improving code performance and maintainability.
  • Used SAP Workbench and the transport management system for deployment to higher environments; supported real client environments.
  • Applied development standards and gained introductory experience in object-oriented ABAP.
